summary: Add one common indicator to each demoted pdl long (p05, p05-lowvol); keep volume, lift avg R
logs: Top indicators: Move from open (stock % from today's open), VWAP position / VWAP cross, RSI(14), Order-flow buy/sell lead (19-bar signed-volume share; 3-bar version), RSI(5), Index context (SPY/QQQ move from open, QQQ vs VWAP), Gap (open vs prior close), 5-min SMA50 (cross / position), MarcoFlow heat (composite score), Relative volume (volume ratio / climax)

indicators.name: Move from open (stock % from today's open)
indicators.column: fromOpen (frame); CWT kernels also use it as a run measured in daily ATRs: open_d = close/(1+fromOpen/100), run = (HOD-open_d)/atr_d
indicators.how_used: Sets which way the stock has moved and how far. Shorts that fade a bounce need the stock DOWN: fromOpen < -2 (NS3, RW4, RWN3/5, RWR3) or < -3 (ST3/4/5/6/8, LD3/4/5). Some shorts and longs need it UP: > +2 (NS1, NS4, LD1, LD7, RWN4) or > +3 (RW6G1, RWR4). Others use < -1 (ST7/ST7Q), < 0 (NM1, HL-T75) or > 3.46 (L3-fromopen). The ATR-run form needs a run of at least 1.0 / 1.5 / 2.5 daily ATR off the open (CWT04 x4, CWT12). orb20 takes its direction from the 09:30-09:49 move. Untried on the PDL parents in its raw form. Only rs = fromOpen - SPY fromOpen >= +0.5% was tried (symbol-quality Q02/Q06/Q11/Q14), so skip that row.

indicators.name: VWAP position / VWAP cross
indicators.column: vwapDistPct (cross = sign change vs the prior bar within the symbol-day; vwapReclaim also exists). VWAP price = close/(1+vwapDistPct/100)
indicators.how_used: (a) Cross or reclaim on this bar: vwapDistPct > 0 with the prior bar <= 0. Used by NS3/NS3-FD/NS3V1, NS4/NS4-FD, RW4 x2, RWN3, RWN5 and RWR3, mostly as shorts after a down-from-open move. (b) Side of VWAP: vwapDistPct > +0.05 (MF1, MF5 x3, ST3, ST6) or below VWAP (ST8, CWT04 backside, NM1/CWT09 VWAP loss). (c) Distance in daily ATR: within 0.5 ATR of VWAP (LD3, LD5); at least 0.5/0.75 ATR below VWAP (CWT13 stretch); room to VWAP >= 2 x 0.25 ATR (LIQ PDL-sweep long, the closest live relative of the PDL parents). (d) VWAP+2SD band guard (RW6G1). Overlap: vd >= +0.5% / vd >= 0 was already tried on the PDL parents (Q01/Q05/Q09/Q10/Q14/Q15/Q16), and so was SPY-vs-VWAP. Untried: a VWAP reclaim on the signal bar, and a 'below VWAP with room' (LIQ-style) filter.

indicators.name: RSI(14)
indicators.how_used: Oversold or crossing: rsi <= 30 (NS4, NS5 x3, ST7, ST7Q). Crosses below 50 (ST7/ST7Q) or below 40 on this bar (NS1 x2, LD1, LD7). Mid-high band 55 <= rsi <= 65 (MF2 x2, RW1, RW7). Strong: rsi >= 60 (RW6G1 x2, RWN4, RWR4) or > 50 (ST4, LD4). Not used in any PDL swarm row. For a PDL-reclaim long the natural cuts are rsi <= 30-40 (oversold) or rsi crossing back up.

indicators.name: Order-flow buy/sell lead (19-bar signed-volume share; 3-bar version)
indicators.column: buyPressure (19-bar); flow3 (3-bar signed-volume share); flow9prev also in frames
indicators.how_used: Flow-sell on shorts: buyPressure < -0.25 (MF2/MF3/MF4/MF5 family, NM-MF3), < -0.15 (RW5) or < -0.35 (RW3, RW1). Buy-side confirmation on longs: buyPressure > 0 (ST7, ST7Q, LD3, LD5), flow3 > 0 (ST8), buyPressure >= 0.31 (AMS-N1, a short). Six of the 10 Primary setups use it. Not used in any PDL swarm row. Natural long cuts: buyPressure > 0, or flow3 > 0 on the reclaim bar.

indicators.name: RSI(5)
indicators.how_used: Short-term pop: rsi5 > 70 (L3-rsi5hi, MF3 x2, MF5 x3, NM-MF3), >= 80 (NS1 x2, LD1, LD7, RW3, RW5) or > 90 (exhaustion x3, RWR1). Short-term oversold: rsi5 <= 20 (ST4, LD4) or crossing back above 20 (ST3). Not a scored filter in any PDL swarm; why/feat.py only carried rsi5 as a descriptive feature. For the long: rsi5 <= 20-30 at the poke, or rsi5 crossing above 20-30 on the reclaim bar.

indicators.name: Index context (SPY/QQQ move from open, QQQ vs VWAP)
indicators.column: spy_fo, qqq_fo (lab context from lib.load_context, or fromOpen of the SPY/QQQ rows in the frame); QQQ vwapDistPct (SPY/QQQ rows) for ST7Q
indicators.how_used: Index up as a short filter: SPY > open or > +0.5% (RWN3, RWN4, RWR1), QQQ > open (RWR3, RWR4). QQQ below open (NM-MF3). QQQ at or below its VWAP (ST7Q long). Index dip then turn: SPY/QQQ running low <= -0.15/-0.30% or -0.20 x ATR, then a close >= low + 0.10 (LD2/3/6/7/8, IDX1/2/3/5 dip-bounce). Stock fromOpen < SPY fromOpen (RWN5). MOSTLY ALREADY COVERED: SPY fromOpen, SPY above VWAP, SPY gap, QQQ/SPY hedges and rs were all tried in tape-flip, combo, why and pdl1030b. Only 'QQQ <= its VWAP' (ST7Q-style) and the 'index dip-then-turn' gate are new.

indicators.name: Gap (open vs prior close)
indicators.column: gap (%); gap_atr = gap in daily ATRs (derived)
indicators.how_used: Gap down: gap <= -2.657 (L3 x3), gapped down / gap < 0 (RW1/3/5/7), gap <= -1 (RWR1), gap <= -10 (CWT09 x2, NM1), gap_atr <= -0.41 / -0.61 (AR-AM, PM-gapdn). Gap up: gap > +1 (ST3, ST6). No gap up: gap <= 0 (NM-MF3). OVERLAP: gap <= -1.5% (Q04/Q13) and the gap-under-PDL variant (B10) were already scored. Untried: gap > 0 (opened above the prior close, then swept the PDL) and gap <= -2.657 (the L3 cut).

indicators.name: 5-min SMA50 (cross / position)
indicators.column: sma50_dist_pct (cross = sign change vs the prior bar)
indicators.how_used: Close crosses above the SMA50 on this bar (RW6G1 x2, RWN4, RWR4, all shorts). Close above the SMA50 (NS3 x3, RW4 x2, RWN3/5, RWR3, ST5). Close breaks below the SMA50 (NS5 x3, flush long). Not used in any PDL swarm row. For the long: reclaim bar closes above the SMA50 (sma50_dist_pct > 0), or still below it (sma50_dist_pct < 0, oversold).

indicators.name: MarcoFlow heat (composite score)
indicators.column: heat (sub-scores also in frames: volumeHeat, rsiHeat, momentumHeat, priceActionHeat, trendHeat, macdHeat, vwapHeat)
indicators.how_used: Only bearish thresholds on shorts: heat <= -30 (MF2/MF3/MF4/MF5 family, RW5, NM-MF3), heat <= -20 (RW3, RW1, RW7), |heat| >= 40 (MF4). Five of the 10 Primary setups use it. Not used in any PDL swarm row. Mirror for the long: heat >= +20/+30 (bullish), or a 'not bearish' gate heat > -20.

indicators.name: Relative volume (volume ratio / climax)
indicators.column: volumeRatio (bar volume / average); vol_climax; volumeSurge; rvol_day = mean volumeRatio since 09:50 (derived)
indicators.how_used: volumeRatio crosses above 2.0 (ST6, ST8). Volume climax >= 3 or 5 on one of the last 3 bars (CWT05 x4). Poke-bar volumeRatio < 1 (CWT14 lowvol: this is the p05-lowvol parent's own condition). Day rvol_day <= 0.8 (AR-AM) or >= 0.84 (PM-gapdn). orb20 takes the top 20 by 09:30-09:49 rvol with rvol >= 1.5. OVERLAP: volumeRatio >= 1.5 on the signal bar was already scored (Q03/Q07/Q12/Q15/Q17), and vr < 1 IS p05-lowvol. Untried: vol_climax on the poke, rvol_day, a volumeRatio >= 2 cross.

results.label: ind1
results.learned:
0 of 13 pre-declared configs pass (N = 121,635 + 5x13 = 121,700; BAR90 t >= 4.355). Parity is exact: p05 -0.0677 / -0.0675 (153.2/session); p05-lowvol TRAIN -0.0951, VALID -0.0948, TRAIN+VALID -0.0950 (101.3/session); p05 S3 -0.0210 / -0.0173.

No row is positive on both TRAIN and VALID, and no t is above 0. Every row loses in total, so the best-day and top-5-day shares are undefined. Removing the top 5 sessions makes each row only 0.005-0.03R worse: the losses are broad and no single day carries them.

Added on the parent exits:
- Move from open > 0 (F1): about +0.01R lift at 44/session (p05) and 29/session (lowvol), but still -0.059 and -0.094.
- Move from open > +2% (F2): the only real lift, to -0.024, but it keeps only 2-4 trades/session.
- Move from open < -2% (F3, washed out then reclaimed): no help.
- VWAP reclaim on the signal bar (V1): p05 -0.057 at 28/session; it hurts lowvol (-0.118).
- Below VWAP with >= 0.5 ATR room (V2, LIQ-style): worse, at 1.5-3.4 trades/session.

On the S3 + cost5 base the picked indicator rows (V1 for p05, F1 for lowvol) add nothing that stands out from noise and cut volume by 70-80%. S-p05: -0.002 at 9.5/session vs the base's -0.005 at 54. S-lv: -0.011 at 11/session vs B-lv's -0.013 at 36.

Every row still makes a little on SPY up days and loses on down days (-0.09..-0.23R). Neither stock-level indicator, known at entry, removes the market beta that drives the loss.

Overlap skipped: rs vs SPY >= +0.5%, stock vd >= 0 / >= +0.5%, and SPY vs VWAP. The third VWAP variant (within 0.5 ATR of VWAP) was dropped so that the B-lv reference fit under the 14-config cap.

results.learned: Educational only — not financial advice. None of the 14 configurations passes. All 14 were declared in PLAN.md before scoring, nothing was added afterwards, and none repeats an earlier PDL row, because no earlier row used RSI(14), buyPressure or flow3. N = 121,705 and the BAR90 bar is t >= 4.355. Parent parity is exact: p05 -0.0677 / -0.0675 at 153.2 trades/session; p05-lowvol -0.0951 / -0.0948 (TRAIN+VALID -0.0950) at 101.3/session; both S3 rows match swarm15; Q08 matches at -0.0028 / -0.0084. Adding RSI(14) or order flow does not help either setup. With the parent's own exits, every row is still negative, between -0.05 and -0.12R. No row beats its parent by more than about 0.016R on both splits. The best row, A4 (p05 + buyPressure > 0), is -0.061 / -0.069 and keeps 60 trades/session. Oversold RSI is slightly better on up days and worse on down days, and strong RSI is the reverse. Buy-side flow helps by about 0.005R and sell-side flow hurts by about the same. The SPY down-day loss (-0.12 to -0.21R) is untouched in every row. Layered on S3 + cost5, A7 (p05 with buyPressure > 0) is about zero: +0.005 / -0.005, t 0.04, 21.8 trades/session, which is below the 25 floor. Its best session is 8.1x its total R, its top 5 sessions are 21x, and without the best day it is -0.002, so the small positive total is a few up days and nothing else. B7 (the lowvol version of the same layer) is -0.006 / -0.020. Top-5-session check: only A7 makes money in total, and it does not hold up once its top sessions are removed. results.learned:

RSI(5) does not help either setup:
- Oversold at the poke (R1) and the short-term pop (R3) are worse than the parent or no better.

QQQ at or below its VWAP (the ST7Q style) hurts, because it picks more weak-tape trades.

- S-lv (R2) is -0.005 TV at 9/session, against B-lv's -0.013 at 36/session.
- VALID is worse than the base in both.

Every row makes money on SPY up days and loses on SPY down days, so the market-beta problem is still there.

Top-5 / one-big-day check: no row has positive total R, so best-day and top-5 shares are undefined. Removing the top 5 sessions lowers each row by about 0.005-0.015R, so the losses are spread across many days.

Skipped as already scored: SPY fromOpen, SPY VWAP, SPY gap, the hedges, and rs vs SPY.

results.learned:
I scored 14 pre-declared configurations and none passes (N = 121,705, bar t >= 4.355). Parent parity matched exactly: p05 -0.0677 / -0.0675 (153.2/session) and p05-lowvol TV -0.0950 (101.3/session). No row has a positive avg R on both TRAIN and VALID, and every row loses in total.

Best-day shares are therefore undefined. I report avg R without the best day and without the top-5 days instead. In every row, removing the best day or the top-5 days makes the loss worse. So no record here is carried by one big day: each is a broad, steady loss, slightly lifted by a few strong up-days.

Gap: a deep gap down into the PDL (G1, gap <= -2.657%, the L3 cut) is the least bad on TRAIN (p05 -0.006). But VALID is -0.035 and it keeps only 7/session (4.6% of trades). The ATR-scaled cut (gap_atr <= -0.41) gives about -0.044 at 21/session. Opening above the prior close (gap > 0) is worse than the parent. Like symbol-quality Q04/Q13, the small lift from gap-down names comes entirely from up-day beta (up-day +0.04R, down-day -0.12R).

SMA50: every rule is worse than or equal to the parent. Reclaim bars above the SMA50 or crossing it lose more, mostly on down sessions (-0.17 to -0.26R). 91% of reclaims are below the SMA50, so M3 is almost the parent itself.

The pre-declared pick rule chose M3 for both S rows. S-p05 (-0.0028 / -0.0084, 49/session) and S-lv (-0.0071 / -0.0177, 32/session) therefore just reproduce the S3+cost5 bases. Both setups stay in the Graveyard.

Overlap skipped: gap <= -1.5% (Q04/Q13), gap <= -3%, and B10 (a short). The SMA50 had never been used in a PDL row. Disclosed approximation: the SMA50 cross compares the prior bar's close with the SMA50 at the signal bar.

results.label: ind5
results.learned:
I scored 14 pre-declared setups (PLAN.md was written before scoring) and none passes. No row has avg R above 0 on both TRAIN and VALID. The best t is -1.19, and the bar is 4.355 with N = 121,705. The baseline (parent) numbers matched exactly: p05 -0.0677 / -0.0675 at 153.2 trades per session, and p05lv -0.0950 at 101.3 per session.

Heat: the 'not bearish' gate (heat > -20) keeps about 90% of trades and changes nothing. Bullish heat >= +20 is worse, especially in VALID, and the bearish heat <= -30 side is the least bad but trades only about 3 per session and still loses. Relative volume: an active day (rvol_day >= 0.84) is worse, with 0% of months positive. Volume spikes (volumeRatio crossing 2.0, or a 3-bar climax >= 3) cut the setup to 2-8 trades per session with no gain.

Adding the pick (heat > -20) on top of the 3x-stop + cost-cap base adds nothing over the base runs already scored (p05 -0.0028 / -0.0084; p05lv -0.0072 / -0.0188). Every row loses on SPY-down days, which is the same market-beta pattern found earlier.

Best-day check: every row's total R is negative, so 'share of total R' cannot be computed. Removing the best day, or the top 5 days, makes every average worse (for example S-p05 goes from -0.0049 to -0.0057 without the best day and to -0.0081 without the top 5). Nothing here is propped up by one big day, because no row has a positive record to begin with.

One finding about the data: in these frames vol_climax is the same column as volumeRatio. Skipped as already tested: volumeRatio >= 1.5 on the signal bar (symbol-quality Q03/Q07/Q12/Q15/Q17), and volumeRatio < 1 on the poke bar, which is p05lv itself.
